landing.heroText: Andika amafaranga yinjiye, yasohotse n'ukwigema byawe buri munsi — urebe neza imari yawe igererwa n'igikoresho gishya kizwi n'abagurishyi bato.
landing.featuresTitle: Byose ukeneye kugira ubunganye n'amafaranga yawe
landing.featuresSubtitle: Bisobanutse, byihuta, kandi bikoresha ibyo mugurishyi muto gihangaye.
landing.f1Text: Tanga icyicaro cyose mu gihe gito, hamwe n'itariki n'uburyo bwo kwishyura.
landing.f2Text: Shyira intego yoroshye urebe ukwigema kwawe kugura.
landing.f3Text: Reba amarari yawe ya buri munsi n'ya buri wezi mu matoranyo yoroshye gusoma.
landing.f4Text: Kora neza ku gice cyose — byakozwe kubw'imezo nini mbere.
landing.f5Text: Amakuru yawe arinzwe n'uburyo bw'umutekano kandi ni ubwawe.
landing.f6Text: Kuramo igiceraga cy CSV cyangwa PDF kugira ngo ucyrebere cyangwa ugirane n'abandi.
landing.ctaTitle: Tangira gushyira ibicuruzwa byawe muri raporo uyu munsi
landing.ctaText: Biratwaye iminusa gusa kugira ngo ukore konti yawe. Ibikakozwe byawe bikaba bibyawe kandi bikaba ibyawe.

authLayout.pitch: Igikoresho gishya gyo kubunganya n'amafaranga kubw'abagurishyi bato b'u Rwanda. Andika ibyinjiye, ibyasohotse n'ukwigema kwawe buri munsi — urebe ibicuruzwa byawe bisobanutse.
authLayout.bullet1: Andika ibyinjiye n'ibyasohotse mu gihe gito

register.otpFailed: Konti yakozwe, ariko ntibyashobotse kohereza imeyili yo kwemeza. Koresha "Ohereza kode nshya" ugerageze ukundi.

forgot.title: Wibagiwe Ijambo ry'ibanga Ryawe?
forgot.intro: Andika aderesi y'imeyili ihari muri konti yawe. Niba konti ifitwe nayo, tuzakohereza urubuga rwo guhindura ijambo ry'ibanga.
forgot.sentBody: Twakiriye icabu cyawe. Niba konti ihari kuriyo, uzakubona urubuga rwo guhindura ijambo ry'ibanga vuba. Reba ububiko bwawe n'ubw' spam.

reset.invalidBody: Uru rubuga ntirufite umumero, rwaheze, cyangwa rwakozwe. Musaba undi munsi.
reset.missingTokenBody: Uyu mugenwa ushushanya urubuga rwo guhindura ijambo ry'ibanga. Musaba fungura urubuga rwayo muri meyili yawe.
reset.title: Hindura Ijambo ry'ibanga Ryawe
reset.intro: Hitamo ijambo rishya ry'ibanga. Ku bw'umutekano wawe, ryomba kuba ry'imigabane {{min}}.
reset.success: Ijambo ryawe ry'ibanga ryahinduwe. Musaba winjire ijambo ryawe rishya.
reset.checkFailedBody: Tumaze kubona seriveri. Reba uruzhu rwawe kandi ongera ugerageze.

dashboard.subtitle: Imari yawe yakadiriwe.
dashboard.noteRest: Ibi bweretse mu byakadiriwe gusa muri BIKA WUNGUKE, ku gihe watoranyije. Ukwigema harerwa ku gundi buryo kandi ntibushyirwa mu byasohotse, kubw'uko amafaranga y'umwanya umwe atagira kabiri.
dashboard.noRecordsDesc: Ongeraho ibikakozwe by'ibinjiye n'ibyasohotse kugira ngo ubone imbere y'amafaranga.
dashboard.noSavingsDesc: Tangira gushyira akantu kacu urebe ukugera ku ntengo yawe.
dashboard.gettingStartedDesc: Nta bikakozwe ufite muri iyi periodi. Ongeraho icyicaro cyawe cyambere cyangwa igiciro kugira ngo utangire gukurikirana ibicuruzwa byawe.

transactions.title: Ibyinjiye n'Ibyasohotse
transactions.subtitle: Igikakozwe cyose ufite, mu rutonde rweretse.
transactions.emptyDesc: Gerageza guhindura muyunguruzi yawe, cyangwa ongeraho igikakozwe cyawe cyambere.

savings.title: Kwigema
savings.subtitle: Shyira amafaranga ku ruhande kandi ukurikirane intego zawe.
savings.infoText: Kwigema bivuga amafaranga <1>wubitswe</1>. Ni ubutumwa bw'ibyo wubitswe — BIKA WUNGUKE <1>ntigusobanura</1> amafaranga ari mu banki, SACCO cyangwa kuri mobile wallet. Ibikakozwe by'ukwigema bifatanijwe n'ibyinjiye n'ibyasohotse byawe, kubw'uko byatabara amafaranga yawe yakadiriwe.
savings.noGoalsDesc: Kora intege ifite intego y'ingano kugira ngo ukurikirane inyungu zawe.
savings.remainingUnknown: Intego igomba kuba ingano yuzuye kugira ngo isigaye.
savings.emptyDesc: Tangira gushyira akantu kacu buri munsi urebe ukugura.
savings.deleteGoalDesc: Intego izasibwa. Imibozo yaranditswe isigaye ahanini ntizakomeza kubifatanya na yo.

savingsModal.disclaimer: Ukwigema ni amafaranga wubitswe. Ibikakozwe by'ukwigema bifatanijwe n'ibyinjiye n'ibyasohotse byawe, kubw'uko byatabara ibicuruzwa byawe.

financialRecord.title: Urupapuro rw'Imari yanjye
financialRecord.subtitle: Urupapuro rweretse ibyo wanditseye muri BIKA WUNGUKE.
financialRecord.disclaimerText: Uru raporo rweretse amakuru <1>wanditeje wenyine</1>. Ni urupapuro rwa gahunda, ubutumwa bw'imariso idakemutse, igipimo cy'ideni, cyangwa ubwishingizi bwo kwishyurwa. Nta kintu koherezwa ku banki, SACCO, wakozwa ideni, cyangwa uweundi usibwe ko wifuza kugirana.
financialRecord.noRecordsDesc: Nta mibozo yabitswe kuri {{label}}. Hindura igihe cyangwa ongeraho ibikakozwe.
financialRecord.nothingInGroup: Nta kintu kiranditswe muri urwo rutonde.
financialRecord.previewIncludes: Irimo imibozo {{count}} n'igererwa ry'ibyiciro. Uru rupapuro rweretse neza ibi PDF iza kubira.
financialRecord.previewReminder: Ubwigishwa: iki kirimo ibyakadiriwe we wanditeje. Ni urupapuro rwa gahunda, ubutumwa bw'imariso idakemutse.
financialRecord.shareWarningRest: Urupapuro rwawe rw'imari rugiranywa gusa iyo wemeza hasi. Nturoherezwa ku banki, SACCO, wakozwa ideni, cyangwa uweundi wenyine.
financialRecord.shareClipboardNote: Niba porogaramu yawe idashobora kugirana, inyandiko y'igi cyo iza kuboneka ku gitabo cya klipibodi.
financialRecord.shareLineNote: Uyu mugenwa wakozwe na BIKA WUNGUKE ubu buryo bw'amakuru njanze yanditseye. Ni urupapuro rwa gahunda, ubutumwa bw'imariso idakemutse.
financialRecord.notSupported: Kugirana ntiraboneka kuri iyi porogaramu. Kuramo PDF.
